description: Full SEC EDGAR filing list for a filer: the filer's filings from the first-seen store, newest first, in the same filing-record shape as secfilings_status, with form and filing-date range filters and cursor paging. The store holds filings of filers this service has touched; a filer never touched before is seeded on-read. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/secfilings/filings.

cik.description: CIK, 1-10 digits — provide cik OR ticker

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

form.description: Optional form filter (exact or base form)

ticker.description: Ticker symbol — provide cik OR ticker

name: sec_filings_list
